measurement_methods.plus: Threshold blue foreground, fill white glyph holes, least-squares visible exterior circle. Image-boundary and keyboard-clipped edges excluded. Frame191–192 fit left/right exterior arcs above keyboard. Circle fit RMS mostly0.35–0.52px; fading disk frame57 RMS0.87px. Radius definition is thresholded visible fill edge, excluding shadow.
measurement_methods.scroll: Normalized cross-correlation against initial Things to buy heading and Power adapter row; their deltas agree to <=1px. Integer source-frame translation samples.
measurement_methods.row_offsets: Normalized cross-correlation of each initial row/heading, plus scroll. Only normalized correlation >=0.9 retained. Read/Borrow use subpixel parabolic refinement.
measurement_methods.gap: Visible gray-shade run below250 luminance on x14:22 strip, visually checked. Thresholded bounds vary a few pixels due compression/soft edges, and are not proven original layout-box bounds.
measurement_methods.editor: White/shadow horizontal edge profiles at center x220:280 plus visual inspection. Opening width measured from left/right luminance edges. Initial frame57 editor bounded visually due fading blue disk overlap.
measurement_methods.keyboard: First sustained nonwhite gray boundary in leftmost four pixels, visually checked;888 represents offscreen.
measurement_methods.opacity: plusAlpha/editorAlpha are explicitly visual interpolation estimates, not uniquely recoverable source-layer alpha. gapAlpha is binary presence, suitable for playback; use a light-gray underlying fill.

uncertainty.pts_seconds: 1/30 sampling. Event onset is only known between preceding and first changed presented frame.
uncertainty.plus_center_radius_px: normally approximately±0.7px; fading frame57±1.5px. Nominal CSS/design radius may differ by ~0.5px due antialias threshold.
uncertainty.editor_width_px: frame58±2px, frame59±2px, fullwidth clips to viewport
uncertainty.alpha: qualitative estimates; approximately±0.15–0.25 for partially transparent material

occlusion_handling.downstream_row_offsets: Measured values with NCC>=0.9 retained. Missing rows copy shared downstream displacement from visible sibling/heading. Frame57 heading top627 is partly keyboard-clipped, so offset255 is labeled an inference based on its visible upper glyphs. Frames58–64 use an estimated approach to hidden expanded offset288; held through186. Those offsets are not recovered from invisible pixels; they keep hidden content out of view and join the measured first collapse positions. Do not report them as source-exact.
occlusion_handling.plus_position: Hidden frames58–190 interpolate an unobserved invisible trajectory; plusAlpha0 prevents showing it.
occlusion_handling.editor: Frame56 tiny zero-alpha bound is only initialization; frames196–225 compact bounds365..423 are inferred retained-row geometry while card shadow vanishes.

additional_appearance_observation.list_content_alpha: Underlying list contrast drops to ~0.49 of original during editor open, returning during collapse; light-gray overlay/background is visible. This is contrast regression, not direct original layer opacity.
